decision.rationale: The ledger shows that one authorisation was posted twice. TXN-007873 and TXN-007874 are both purchases at WILLOWMERE GADGETS (MER-000041) for 136.74 EUR. TXN-007873 was made at 2026-07-29T20:48:09Z and TXN-007874 at 20:51:09Z, and both posted on 2026-07-30. Both carry the same authorisation, AUTH-008085, which was approved once for 13674 cents at 20:48:09Z, the time of TXN-007873. That makes TXN-007874 the extra posting. No refund of either posting appears on the card at this merchant. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-31, 93 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. Under duplicate-same-authorisation, the extra posting gets provisional credit. Its amount, 136.74 EUR, is below the 3,000.00 EUR automated limit in provisional-credit. The credit covers one posting only, which matches the cardholder's claim.
